## Overview Adds regression tests for #63597 (symmetric GPTQ crashes on the RDNA hybrid W4A16 kernel). The fix itself is #52637 by tangzzycc; this PR only adds tests for it. **Depends on #52637: please merge after it.** ## Claims - A layer test drives a symmetric GPTQ layer through the real `AutoGPTQLinearMethod` path (`create_weights` → `process_weights_after_loading` → `apply`) on `RDNAHybridW4A16LinearKernel` and compares with a dequantized reference, for both the HIP skinny path (M=1) and the Triton path (M=64). - It covers a case #52637's description does not mention: when K/G == N/8, the stale `qzeros` passes every shape and stride check, and the kernel silently uses zero point 7 instead of 8 (output error ≈ 0.36 against a 2e-2 tolerance). - An end-to-end test loads a real symmetric GPTQ checkpoint (`JunHowie/Qwen3-0.6B-GPTQ-Int4`) on the hybrid kernel and compares logprobs with the Triton kernel, asserting which kernel each run used. ## Validation Hardware: AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 (gfx1201, RDNA4), WSL2. vLLM `main` cannot be built here, so the tests ran in `rocm/vllm:rocm10.1.0_ubuntu24.04_py3.14-pytorch_2.13.0_vllm-0.29.0` (vLLM `0.29.1.dev0+g98dff2a81`): once with the image's own `auto_gptq.py` (fails), once with #52637's 4-line loader change applied to that file (passes). The test files are identical to this PR. ```bash pytest tests/kernels/quantization/test_rdna_hybrid_w4a16_gptq.py tests/models/quantization/test_gptq_rdna_hybrid.py ``` Without the fix (the image's own `auto_gptq.py`) — 5 failed: ```text FAILED kernels/quantization/test_rdna_hybrid_w4a16_gptq.py::test_symmetric_gptq_matches_reference[256-128-128-M=1_skinny] FAILED kernels/quantization/test_rdna_hybrid_w4a16_gptq.py::test_symmetric_gptq_matches_reference[256-128-128-M=64_triton] FAILED kernels/quantization/test_rdna_hybrid_w4a16_gptq.py::test_symmetric_gptq_matches_reference[2048-128-128-M=1_skinny] FAILED kernels/quantization/test_rdna_hybrid_w4a16_gptq.py::test_symmetric_gptq_matches_reference[2048-128-128-M=64_triton] FAILED models/quantization/test_gptq_rdna_hybrid.py::test_gptq_rdna_hybrid_matches_triton[5-32] E RuntimeError: Zero points dtype must match activation dtype (M=1, HIP skinny path) E AssertionError: zp shape mismatch: torch.Size([2, 16]) vs (128, 2) (M=64, Triton path) E AssertionError: zp shape mismatch: torch.Size([8, 512]) vs (4096, 8) (end-to-end: EngineCore failed to start) ``` On this older image the K/G == N/8 case also fails loudly (its kernel checks `(N, num_groups)`); on `main` the zero-point layout is `[N/8, K/G]`, so there the stale `qzeros` passes the shape and stride checks and only the numeric comparison catches it. With #52637's loader change — 5 passed: ```text PASSED kernels/quantization/test_rdna_hybrid_w4a16_gptq.py::test_symmetric_gptq_matches_reference[256-128-128-M=1_skinny] PASSED kernels/quantization/test_rdna_hybrid_w4a16_gptq.py::test_symmetric_gptq_matches_reference[256-128-128-M=64_triton] PASSED kernels/quantization/test_rdna_hybrid_w4a16_gptq.py::test_symmetric_gptq_matches_reference[2048-128-128-M=1_skinny] PASSED kernels/quantization/test_rdna_hybrid_w4a16_gptq.py::test_symmetric_gptq_matches_reference[2048-128-128-M=64_triton] PASSED models/quantization/test_gptq_rdna_hybrid.py::test_gptq_rdna_hybrid_matches_triton[5-32] ``` CI coverage: vLLM CI has no gfx11/gfx12 runners. On CUDA the files skip at module level; on MI300/MI355 every test skips (the hybrid kernel is gfx11/gfx12 only, and gfx1100 selects `RDNA3W4A16LinearKernel` first). The tests therefore run only on RDNA hardware; the results above are that run.
Related end-to-end numbers with #52637 on the same GPU (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B GPTQ Int4, not part of this PR's claims) Same image, #52637's loader change applied, `--max-model-len 8192 --max-num-seqs 4`, `vllm bench serve` random 1024 in / 512 out, median of 3 runs: | Kernel | 1 request tok/s | 1 request TTFT | 4 requests tok/s | GSM8K (200, greedy) | |---|---|---|---|---| | `TritonW4A16LinearKernel` (today's workaround) | 37.8 | 2190 ms | 96.2 | 87.0% ± 2.4 | | `RDNAHybridW4A16LinearKernel` (with #52637) | 60.1 | 227 ms | 143.4 | 86.5% ± 2.4 |
## Details - Why not a duplicate: #52637 fixes the bug and includes a unit test with a mock kernel; #61891 (draft) was asked for a regression test. This PR adds no fix, only tests on the real kernel and a real checkpoint. If the #52637 author prefers, these two files can be folded into that PR instead. - The layer test builds the layer with `AutoGPTQLinearMethod.create_weights` (not the existing dummy-layer helper), because the bug is that the GPTQ loader's `qzeros` reaches the kernel; the dummy layer never registers it. - AI assistance (Claude) was used to write these tests and this description. I reviewed every line and ran the tests above. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) ---
Pull Request Checklist - [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,93 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Symmetric GPTQ layers on the ROCm W4A16 kernels, via `AutoGPTQLinearMethod`.
+
+Run `pytest tests/kernels/quantization/test_rdna_hybrid_w4a16_gptq.py`.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+    pytest.skip("ROCm only", allow_module_level=True)
+
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.mixed_precision import (  # noqa: E402
+    RDNAHybridW4A16LinearKernel,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.auto_gptq import (  # noqa: E402
+    AutoGPTQConfig,
+    AutoGPTQLinearMethod,
+)
+from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx1x, on_gfx1100  # noqa: E402
+
+device = "cuda"
+PACK = 8
+# Symmetric GPTQ checkpoints store every zero point as 7 (8 - 1).
+SYMMETRIC_QZEROS_WORD = 0x77777777
+
+
+def _make_layer(K: int, N: int, G: int, dtype: torch.dtype):
+    config = AutoGPTQConfig(
+        weight_bits=4,
+        group_size=G,
+        desc_act=False,
+        is_sym=True,
+        lm_head_quantized=False,
+        dynamic={},
+        full_config={},
+    )
+    method = AutoGPTQLinearMethod(config)
+    layer = torch.nn.Module()
+    with torch.device(device):
+        method.create_weights(
+            layer,
+            input_size_per_partition=K,
+            output_partition_sizes=[N],
+            input_size=K,
+            output_size=N,
+            params_dtype=dtype,
+            weight_loader=lambda *args, **kwargs: None,
+        )
+
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+    q = torch.randint(0, 16, (K, N), generator=gen, dtype=torch.int32)
+    shifts = (torch.arange(PACK, dtype=torch.int32) * 4).view(1, PACK, 1)
+    packed = torch.sum(q.view(K // PACK, PACK, N) << shifts, dim=1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    scales = (0.01 + 0.04 * torch.rand((K // G, N), generator=gen)).to(dtype)
+
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        layer.qweight.data.copy_(packed)
+        layer.scales.data.copy_(scales)
+        layer.qzeros.data.fill_(SYMMETRIC_QZEROS_WORD)
+    return method, layer, q, scales
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not on_gfx1x() or on_gfx1100(), reason="Needs the RDNA hybrid kernel (gfx11/gfx12)"
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("M", [1, 64], ids=["M=1_skinny", "M=64_triton"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "K, N, G",
+    [
+        (256, 128, 128),  # K/G != N/8: stale qzeros fail the zp shape check
+        (2048, 128, 128),  # K/G == N/8: stale qzeros pass checks, output wrong
+    ],
+)
+def test_symmetric_gptq_matches_reference(K, N, G, M, dist_init):
+    dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    method, layer, q, scales = _make_layer(K, N, G, dtype)
+    assert isinstance(method.kernel, RDNAHybridW4A16LinearKernel)
+
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1)
+    x = (0.25 * torch.randn((M, K), generator=gen)).to(device, dtype)
+    w = (q.to(device, torch.float32) - 8.0) * scales.to(
+        device, torch.float32
+    ).repeat_interleave(G, dim=0)
+    ref = (x.to(torch.float32) @ w).to(dtype)
+
+    method.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+    out = method.apply(layer, x)
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out, ref, rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-2)

@@ -0,0 +1,71 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Symmetric GPTQ model on the RDNA hybrid W4A16 kernel vs. the Triton kernel."""
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.mixed_precision import (
+    RDNAHybridW4A16LinearKernel,
+    TritonW4A16LinearKernel,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from ..utils import check_logprobs_close
+
+if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+    pytest.skip("ROCm only", allow_module_level=True)
+
+from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx1x, on_gfx1100  # noqa: E402
+
+MODEL = "JunHowie/Qwen3-0.6B-GPTQ-Int4"
+MAX_MODEL_LEN = 1024
+
+
+def _kernel_name(model) -> str:
+    return type(model.model.layers[0].self_attn.qkv_proj.quant_method.kernel).__name__
+
+
+def _run(vllm_runner, example_prompts, max_tokens, num_logprobs, expected_kernel):
+    with vllm_runner(
+        MODEL,
+        quantization="gptq",
+        dtype="bfloat16",
+        max_model_len=MAX_MODEL_LEN,
+        enforce_eager=True,
+    ) as model:
+        assert model.apply_model(_kernel_name) == [expected_kernel.__name__]
+        return model.generate_greedy_logprobs(example_prompts, max_tokens, num_logprobs)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not on_gfx1x() or on_gfx1100(), reason="Needs the RDNA hybrid kernel (gfx11/gfx12)"
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("max_tokens", [32])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_logprobs", [5])
+def test_gptq_rdna_hybrid_matches_triton(
+    vllm_runner,
+    example_prompts,
+    monkeypatch,
+    enable_pickle,
+    max_tokens: int,
+    num_logprobs: int,
+) -> None:
+    hybrid_outputs = _run(
+        vllm_runner,
+        example_prompts,
+        max_tokens,
+        num_logprobs,
+        RDNAHybridW4A16LinearKernel,
+    )
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS", RDNAHybridW4A16LinearKernel.__name__)
+    triton_outputs = _run(
+        vllm_runner, example_prompts, max_tokens, num_logprobs, TritonW4A16LinearKernel
+    )
+
+    check_logprobs_close(
+        outputs_0_lst=triton_outputs,
+        outputs_1_lst=hybrid_outputs,
+        name_0="triton",
+        name_1="rdna_hybrid",
+    )
